references.text: The specific birth event in 30:10 is confirmed and placed within the broader editorial context of the genealogy in 46:18.
The verse in 35:26 confirms the identity of the two sons who began with the event in 30:10 and establishes their lineage.
The verse in 29:24 explains the origin of Zilpah's role as a maidservant, which led to the event in 30:10.
Confirms that Zilpah's sons (from 30:10) legally and theologically belong to Leah and her household.
Creates an important theological contrast by listing Leah's own sons, distinguishing them from Zilpah's sons mentioned in 30:10.
